label: uc-pms-n5
_why: Urban-centre production methods, n=5, sampled at 1836.2.1 and 1838.2.1. Two questions: is the Feb-1836 reading representative or still settling, and does it vary run to run. The scenario needs the CAPITAL STATE's methods per country, selected at analysis time from history's own `capital = STATE_X` rather than by a world-wide majority - a majority over all states mixes a developed capital with undeveloped provinces, which is how Russia ended up with free urban clergy when its capital runs state clergy.
